description: This Java source file defines a JUnit 5 extension class 'WithSystemTimeZoneExtension' that manages system timezone settings during test execution. It temporarily changes the timezone based on annotations on test methods and restores the original timezone after the test runs.

classes.name: WithSystemTimeZoneExtension
classes.description: A JUnit 5 extension that modifies the system timezone before each test if annotated, and restores the original timezone after the test.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Stores the current timezone and sets a new timezone based on annotation before each test.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Restores the original timezone after each test.

methods.name: getTimeZoneId
methods.description: Extracts the timezone ID from the test method annotation.

methods.name: hasAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if the test method has the @WithSystemTimeZone annotation.
